Title: Matcha Latte
Description: whisking ceremonial or culinary matcha powder with warm water and pouring it over milk and ice

Title: Strawberry Matcha Latte
Description: heavily layered drink featuring mashed strawberries or strawberry syrup paired with green tea and creamy milk

Title: Dirty Matcha Latte
Description: Classic Uji 6g Matcha latte topped with 1 Single Double Shot 18g - 2oz Medium Dark roast espresso.

Title: Hojicha Latte
Description: Whisked Uji Hojicha over milk, sweetened with house made simple syrup.

Title: Iced Brown Sugar Hojicha Latte
Description: Brown sugar molasses sweetened milk topped with whisked Uji region Hojicha

Title: Double Matcha (Hojicha + Matcha Cloud)
Description: Toasted, earthy hojicha layered beneath a velvety, cold-whipped matcha foam for a rich study in contrasts.

Title: Spakling Matcha
Description: Crisp, effervescent sparkling water infused with ceremonial matcha and a touch of citrus brightener.

Title: Spakling Guava Matcha
Description: Tropical pink guava nectar meets effervescent green tea for a sweet, refreshing, and vibrant iced refresher.
